results.title: Gaming Laptops in the Current Market: What Has Changed and What to Look For
results.description: Gaming laptops have gone through a genuine transformation over the past several years. The machines that defined the category for most of its history were thick, heavy, loud, and ran hot enough to make extended gaming sessions uncomfortable.
